AcceptSignupsHelp: Turn off to lock the link. Turn on to unlock it after too many wrong PIN tries.
AccessScheduleHelp: Limits access to these days and hours.
ActivityExpiryDeletedOverviewMany: {0} users were deleted when their group expired in {1}: {2}
ActivityExpiryDeletedOverviewOne: {0} user was deleted when their group expired in {1}: {2}
ActivityExpiryDisabledOverviewMany: {0} users were disabled when their group expired in {1}: {2}
ActivityExpiryDisabledOverviewOne: {0} user was disabled when their group expired in {1}: {2}
ActivityInactiveDisabledOverviewMany: {0} users were disabled for inactivity in {1}: {2}
ActivityInactiveDisabledOverviewOne: {0} user was disabled for inactivity in {1}: {2}
ActivityInviteLockedOverview: The invite {0} was locked after {1} incorrect PIN attempts
ActivityInviteLockedOverviewOne: The invite {0} was locked after 1 incorrect PIN attempt
ActivityInviteUsedUpOverview: The invite {0} reached its limit of {1} uses
ActivityInviteUsedUpOverviewOne: The invite {0} reached its limit of 1 use
ActivityInvitesExpiredOverview: {0} invites were disabled at their expiry date: {1}
ActivityInvitesExpiredOverviewOne: 1 invite was disabled at their expiry date: {0}
ActivityPasswordChangeBlockedOverview: The group disallows self-service password changes
ActivityRulesEnrolledOverviewMany: {0} users were enrolled in group password rules: {1}
ActivityRulesEnrolledOverviewOne: {0} user was enrolled in group password rules: {1}
ActivityRulesRemovedOverviewMany: {0} users were removed from group password rules: {1}
ActivityRulesRemovedOverviewOne: {0} user was removed from group password rules: {1}
ActivitySessionsLoggedOutOverviewMany: {0} stale sessions were logged out from {1}
ActivitySessionsLoggedOutOverviewOne: {0} stale session was logged out from {1}
AddNewUsersToGroupHelp: Choosing the default group keeps the invite pointed at whichever group is the default when it is redeemed.
AllChannelsHelp: Turn off to pick the channels members can open.
AllDevicesHelp: Turn off to pick the devices members can sign in from.
AllLibrariesHelp: Turn off to pick the libraries members can open.
AllowedTagsHelp: Shows only media with at least one of these tags.
BitrateLimitHelp: Limits each stream to devices outside the local network. Leave blank for no limit.
BlockedTagsHelp: Hides media with at least one of these tags.
CleanUpOldSessionsHelp: Logs out members' devices that go too long without checking in. The Clean expired sessions task does this, so its schedule sets when.
CollectionsViewHelp: Shows a Collections entry beside the libraries on the home screen.
ConfirmDeleteGroup: Delete the group {0}? Its members are unassigned.
ConfirmDeleteInvite: Delete this invite? The link stops working.
ConfirmSaveDeleteOnExpiry: Save {0}? It deletes its members on {1}, and this cannot be undone.
ContentDownloadHelp: Lets members save media to their devices. Book libraries need this to work.
DeletionAccessHelp: Turn off to pick the libraries members can delete from.
DisableInactiveUsersHelp: Disables members who stop using the server.
DisallowEmptyPasswordsHelp: While off, an empty password always passes, since it means the account has no password.
EmptyGroups: No groups yet. Select New to add one.
EmptyInvites: No invites yet. Create one above.
EmptyRules: No rules yet. Select Add rule to add one.
EnforcePasswordRequirementsHelp: Holds members' passwords to the rules below.
ErrorCreateAccount: Could not create the account. Please try again.
ErrorCreateGroupFirst: Create a group on the Groups tab first.
ErrorEnterFullUrl: Enter a full http or https URL.
ErrorGroupBlocksInvites: This group disallows all password changes, so it cannot be used for invites. Members of it are managed by administrators.
ErrorGroupNameTaken: A group with this name already exists.
ErrorInternal: An internal error occurred. Check server logs for details.
ErrorInviteExpiredEnable: This invite has expired. Move its expiration forward to enable it.
ErrorInviteExpiredPassed: This invite's expiration date has passed. Move the expiration forward to re-enable it.
ErrorInviteGroupBlocks: This invite's group disallows all password changes, so the invite cannot be enabled. Change the group's password mode first.
ErrorInviteGroupBlocksEnable: This invite's group disallows all password changes, so it cannot be enabled.
ErrorInviteGroupExpired: This invite's group has expired, so it can no longer be used to create accounts. Ask the server administrator for a new invite.
ErrorInviteLinkInvalid: This invite link is not valid.
ErrorInviteLocked: Too many incorrect PIN attempts. This invite has been locked.
ErrorInviteUnavailable: This invite is no longer available.
ErrorInviteUsedRecently: This invite was used recently. Please try again later.
ErrorInviteUsedUp: This invite has already been fully used.
ErrorLoadGroups: Could not load the groups. Reload the page.
ErrorMaxUses: Maximum usages must be 1 or higher.
ErrorNoDefaultGroup: No default group is configured. Set one on the Groups tab, or choose a specific group for this invite.
ErrorPasswordChangesDisabled: Password changes are disabled for your account. Ask your server administrator to change it for you.
ErrorPasswordNeedsCapital: Password must contain at least one capital letter.
ErrorPasswordNeedsNumber: Password must contain at least one number.
ErrorPasswordNeedsSymbol: Password must contain at least one symbol.
ErrorPasswordTooShort: Password must be at least {0} characters long.
ErrorPinFormat: The PIN must be exactly 6 digits, like a Quick Connect code.
ErrorResourceInvalid: Each resource needs a title and a full http or https URL.
ErrorSaveInviteSettings: Could not save the invite settings.
ErrorSelectExpiration: Select an expiration date or turn off the expiration.
ErrorSelectGroup: Select a group for this invite.
ErrorSignupRefused: An unknown error occurred. Please check your inputs and try again.
ErrorTooManyAttempts: Too many attempts from your network. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
ErrorUsernameNotAllowed: That username isn't allowed. Try a different one.
ExpirationMethodHelp: Disable can be undone. Delete removes each member and their data for good.
ExpireMembersOnDateHelp: Disables or deletes every member once the date comes.
ExpiryDateHelp: The next Process expired and inactive users task run on or after this date expires members.
ForceRemoteTranscodingHelp: Limiting transcoding can make playback fail on clients that cannot play the source format.
GroupExpiredWarning: This group has expired. Signups into it are refused until its expiration date is moved or cleared on the Groups tab.
GroupFoldersIntoViewsHelp: Groups the picked folders into views such as Movies, Music, and TV. The rest show in their own view.
GroupsIntro: Groups apply settings to many users at once, and a user belongs to one group at a time. Only settings marked Group reach members, and the rest stay as each member has them.
HomeScreenSectionsHelp: Sets the order of the home screen sections in the web client.
InactiveDaysHelp: The next Process expired and inactive users task run disables members with no activity for this long. Members who never signed in are left alone.
InviteExpirationHelp: Expires on or after this date during the next Process expired and inactive users task run.
InviteHttpsWarning: It is not recommended to use a non-HTTPS link for invites. Passwords are sent over this link so any non-encrypted traffic can be surveilled.
InviteNameHelp: Only shown here, never to the invitee.
InviteUnavailableMessage: This invite link is invalid, expired, or has been fully used.
InvitesIntro: Create a shareable signup link. Anyone with the link and the PIN can create one account until the invite expires or runs out of uses.
LabelAllowDeletionFromAllLibraries: Allow media deletion from all libraries
LabelAllowLyricManagement: Allow this user to edit lyrics
LabelAllowPreferenceAccess: Allow this user to change their own preferences
LabelHideWatchedFromLatest: Hide watched content from recently added media
LibrariesInHomeSectionsHelp: Picks the libraries in sections such as Recently Added Media and Continue Watching.
LibrariesOnHomeScreenHelp: Picks the libraries in the My Media row.
LoginAttemptsHelp: Set 0 for the default of three tries. Set -1 to never lock out.
MaxRatingHelp: Hides content rated higher than this. Leave blank for no limit.
MediaLibraryOrderHelp: Sets the order libraries appear on the home screen.
MissingEpisodesHelp: TV libraries must also have this turned on in the server settings.
PasswordChangesHelp: Sets whether members may set or change their own password. Administrators always can.
PinHelp: A 6 digit code the invitee must enter, like a Quick Connect code. The invite locks itself after too many wrong tries.
PinHelpAttempts: A short code the invitee must enter. The invite locks itself after {0} wrong tries.
PreferenceAccessHelp: While off, only an administrator or this group changes display and playback preferences.
PublicSharingHelp: Lets members create public share links for media.
RateLimitHelp: After this many signups through one invite, that link pauses for the window. Set either to 0 to disable. Separately, each network address is always limited to 10 signup attempts every 15 minutes, successful or not.
RememberAudioHelp: Picks the audio track closest to the one used in the last video.
RememberSubtitleHelp: Picks the subtitle track closest to the one used in the last video.
RemoteAccessHelp: Blocks every remote connection while off.
ResetsDisabled: Reset code extraction is disabled. Enable it above to list pending codes.
ResetsHttpsWarning: Reset codes are sent over this connection. Use HTTPS so they cannot be read in transit.
ResetsIntro: When a user starts the Forgot Password flow, Jellyfin writes a reset code to a file on the server. This tab shows those codes so you can pass one to the user without file access to the server.
ResourcesHelp: Link buttons shown to the new user after their account is created.
ServerUrlHelp: Public address used to build invite links, such as a reverse proxy. Leave blank to use the server's own address.
SessionOverlapWarning: More than one rule covers {0}. The shortest window applies where rules overlap.
SessionRulesHelp: Each rule logs out devices on its clients after that many days without checking in. A rule for all clients ignores its client list.
SharedDevicesHelp: DLNA devices count as shared until a user starts controlling them.
SyncPlayHelp: Sets whether members can watch in sync with other people.
SyncTranscodingHelp: Lets the server transcode media that a client downloads for offline use.
TaskApplyGroupsDescription: Re-applies each group's permission template to its members.
TaskAssignUsersDescription: Adds users not yet in any group to the default group.
TaskCleanSessionsDescription: Logs out devices that have not checked back into the server within their group's session cleanup windows.
TaskProcessExpiredDescription: Disables or deletes members of expired groups, disables inactive members, and disables expired invites.
ToastInviteCopied: Settings copied into the form. Review and create the invite.
ToastInviteCopiedPin: Settings copied into the form. Set a new PIN, then create the invite.
ToastInviteCreatedGroupExpired: Invite created, but its group has expired. The link does not work until the group expiration is moved or cleared.
UsagesHelp: Invite link is disabled after this number of people use it.
WelcomeMessageHelp: Shown to the invitee under the signup heading.
